qonun.label: Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan

hierarchy.note: Highest grouping in codes; maps to AKN title. See ambiguity note on bo'lim mapping.

hcontainers.name: bolim
hcontainers.use_when: bo'lim cannot be cleanly mapped to title due to structural conflict

kodeks.label: Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan

hierarchy.note: Highest structural grouping in all major codes (Criminal, Civil, Civil Procedure)

kodeks.note: Codes use article numbering continuous throughout all bo'lims and bobs. Civil Code split across two enacted instruments (Part One 1995, Part Two 1996) with continuous article numbering — model as single work.

farmon.label: Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan

hierarchy.note: Shorter decrees may use numbered paragraphs (band) rather than articles; use ARTICLE keyword in Bluebell and note the local term

hcontainers.name: paragraph
hcontainers.use_when: decree uses numbered paragraph (band) structure without article headings

farmon.note: Presidential decrees (farmon) are normative acts with the same article hierarchy as laws. Simple decrees may lack chapter grouping and use only numbered articles or bands.

constitution.label: Constitution of the Republic of Uzbekistan

frbr.number_note: Use the LRU sequential number (e.g., 682 from LRU-682) as the {number} segment. Record the O'RQ citation (e.g., O'RQ-682-son) as <FRBRalias>. For pre-LRU laws, use session number without suffix (e.g., 163 from No. 163-I).

enacting_formulae.note: Appears as document type label in the identification block, not as a body enacting formula. The legislative process is recorded in metadata (adopted by Legislative Chamber on [date], approved by Senate on [date], signed by President on [date]).
Russian-language equivalent of the identification block label

amendments.phrasing: [Act citation]ning [N]-moddasiga quyidagi o'zgartishlar kiritilsin: [N]-moddaning [N]-qismi quyidagi tahrirda bayon etilsin: [new text]
amendments.phrasing_english: The following amendments shall be made to Article [N] of [Act citation]: Part [N] of Article [N] shall be stated in the following wording: [new text]
amendments.omnibus_note: Uzbekistan frequently uses omnibus amendment laws modifying 10-30 acts simultaneously. Each amended act section uses <mod>/<quotedStructure> within a single parent <act> document.

structuring.prompt_additions: Use ARTICLE as the basic unit (not SECTION). Higher divisions are TITLE (bo'lim) and CHAPTER (bob). Article subdivisions use PARAGRAPH (qism, numbered 1 2 3) and POINT (band, lettered a b v). Articles are numbered continuously throughout the entire act regardless of chapter. Do not use SECTION or PART keywords.

supranational_memberships.note: CIS instruments require domestic ratification before taking effect

display.script_note: Primary display in Latin-script Uzbek. Russian translation shown as secondary. Cyrillic Uzbek treated as alternate manifestation during transition period.
